Container.Name: epson-broker
Container.Overview:
Power broker for an Epson LS11000 projector. Keeps authoritative power state over PJLink (gentle polling plus the projector's class 2 UDP notifications) and exposes power on/off to Home Assistant (via the bundled custom_component), a REST API, and a built-in web panel.
Set the projector's Projector Control > Notified IP Address to this server's IP so remote-control power changes show up immediately. See docs/INSTALL.md.
Container.Description: Power broker for an Epson LS11000 projector over PJLink, with REST, WebSocket and Home Assistant control.

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Holds broker.yaml (projector address, polling, HTTP port, input names). Must persist across container updates.
